query: (tendinopathy OR "sports rehabilitation" OR "sports injury" OR "low back pain" OR "neck pain" OR "anterior cruciate ligament") AND (rehabilitation OR exercise OR physiotherapy) AND (PUB_TYPE:"randomized controlled trial" OR PUB_TYPE:"systematic review" OR PUB_TYPE:"meta analysis" OR PUB_TYPE:"practice guideline")
focus: Private-practice sports and musculoskeletal physiotherapy with active adults and athletes. Priority conditions: tendinopathy (Achilles, patellar), low back pain including discogenic pain, neck pain including referred pain, adductor-related groin pain, ACL and knee, hamstring and running injuries. Priority content: exercise and load management, rehabilitation dosing, return to sport, outcome measures and strength testing. Prefer randomised trials, systematic reviews and guidelines that could change or confirm treatment.
